limitations.quote: Keep the final 0 as the prefix of a possible overlap
limitations.note: The patch correctly moved the match pulse to the edge that samples the final zero, but it also changed the post-match transitions for an invalid sample or a valid 1, enabling overlaps that the correct fix does not introduce.
The test oracle used a sliding window of valid bits, so it expected overlapping matches and accepted the extra pulses instead of checking that the original post-match behavior was preserved.
